name: acme.ledger
description: A sample data plugin: a SQLite ledger the project owns, and a small tool roster that lets agents in this project read and append to it.

databases.description: Household transactions, amounts in integer cents. Write through the Household ledger tools, or with sqlite3 under the rules in .daintree/plugins/acme.ledger/AGENTS.md.

agentMcp.name: Household ledger
agentMcp.description: Read and append transactions in this project's ledger database.
